### internal class LocationGizmo — LocationGizmo.cs:13
Draws every Location in the Scene view as an icon lying on the floor, its arrow along the location's forward (+Z), with the id written flat behind it (along -Z). A gizmo, so the "Location" row of the Gizmos dropdown turns it on and off. Clicking it selects the location.
